text: The input image is partitioned into regular patches, with a large portion randomly masked out.
Only the remaining unmasked visible patches are extracted for processing.
A Transformer encoder operates exclusively on the sequence of visible patches.
This generates latent feature representations for the unmasked visual tokens.
The full sequence is reassembled by interleaving the encoded features with learnable mask tokens.
A Transformer decoder processes the complete set of latent representations and mask tokens.
The decoder generates reconstructed outputs across all patch positions.
Finally, the full image is reconstructed at the pixel level to match the original target.
